newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Roly wins China kids clothing licences.
newsitem.headline: Roly wins China kids clothing licences.

text.p: Home decor and consumer products company Roly International Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it had secured three new licences for its children's products business in China, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau.

It said in a statement the licences were for distribution of goods from the "Peanuts Collection" in China, exclusive distribution of "Babble Boon" products in Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau, and distribution of "Batman and Robin" goods in Hong Kong and Macau.
The company would make, distribute and sell children's branded clothing and accessories.
It said the licences would help the company achieve a greater market share of the children's consumer goods business in China.
"Barring any unforeseen circumstances, they are expected to contribute about 15 percent to turnover for licenced consumer goods for FY (the financial year) 1998," it said.
